Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the VPC option looks like a strong fit for our regulated workloads. We have a two-week POC scheduled next Monday but the security committee has asked for a locked-down environment (private network + audit evidence) before they’ll sign off.

- Will you allocate promotional credits we can apply to the Dedicated/VPC trial? Our procurement team prefers a credit-backed evaluation before committing to reserved capacity.

If helpful, Security can share a short checklist of required artifacts (SOC2 summary, network diagram, endpoint controls).

We’re targeting a security decision by Jan 30, so a quick confirmation would help us plan.
